text: Figure 10.2: Signal-based deployment of ServiceInterface [TPS_MANI_03120] Signal-based ServiceInterface binding ⌈ The Signal- BasedServiceInterfaceDeployment meta-class provides the ability to bind a ServiceInterface that is referenced in the role serviceInterface to a signal- based communication protocol like CAN or FlexRay .⌋(RS_MANI_00029) Please note that in contrast to other ServiceInterfaceDeployments that are de- scribed in section 7.1, the communication is not described with AdaptivePlatform- ServiceInstance elements but with a Signal-to-Service Mapping and a classic plat- form System Description. 296 of 458 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 713: AUTOSAR_TPS_ManifestSpecification
